title: DOMINO CLASSIC
one_line: Classic Draw and Block dominoes: play a friend online with a room code, or take on smart computer opponents.
how_to_play: Tap a glowing tile, then tap (or drag it to) the gold end of the chain. Stuck? Draw (or pass in Block mode). Empty your hand first. Tap PLAY A FRIEND ONLINE to play someone with a 5-letter room code.
description: A polished take on classic dominoes. Play a friend online: create a room, send the invite link or 5-letter code, and play Draw or Block dominoes head to head, or 4-player teams with computer players filling empty seats. Offline you get three computer levels (Easy, Medium, Hard), a hard daily challenge with the same deal for everyone, hints, undo, statistics and a winning streak to beat. Works on phones, tablets and desktop.
